programme.title: 14 Phere
programme.desc: Sanjay, a Rajput, is in love with Aditi, a Jat, and wants to get married. However, they realise that their parents would never allow it, so they come up with a cunning plan to get married.

programme.title: Bhoot Returns
programme.desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with Taman and Nimmi, their son and daughter respectively. However, strange occurrences start taking place and they must escape in order to survive.

programme.title: Kadvi Hawa
programme.desc: A blind old man, worried about the survival and well-being of his son, decides to strike a deal with a debt collector to prevent his child from falling into a debt trap.

programme.title: Oh, My God!!
programme.desc: A salesman's failed attempts at wealth lead to divine intervention and life lessons.

programme.title: Happy Bhaag Jaayegi
programme.desc: On the day of her wedding, Happy, a spirited Indian woman, elopes to marry Guddu, the man she loves. But when she mistakenly arrives at the home of a Pakistani politician, chaos erupts.

programme.title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
programme.desc: A shy boy, Mudit, manages to woo Sugandha and the two decide to get married. However, before the wedding, their relationship undergoes a setback as they discover his erectile dysfunction.

programme.title: Janhit Mein Jaari
programme.desc: With the will to break taboo as her armour of choice, Mannu embarks to work as a condom salesperson, despite the reservations of her family and society.

programme.title: Kudrat Ka Kanoon
programme.desc: When the good doctor Vijay is falsely accused and imprisoned, his wife and daughter, desperately seeking justice, are terrorised and slandered by the harsh eyes of society.

programme.title: Mashooq
programme.desc: Karan and Neha fall madly in love with each other. However, they are unaware of the ugly rivalry between their families that had resulted in the death of Neha's uncle.

programme.title: Apaharan
programme.desc: Ajay, an aspiring policeman, borrows money from a moneylender to pursue his dream. However, he is unable to repay the loan on time and decides to be a part of a kidnapping scheme.

programme.title: Kalyug
programme.desc: Kunal and Renuka's marital bliss is shattered when a group of people film and upload a video of them being intimate on an adult website. Kunal fights to take them and their illegal racket down.

programme.title: Shirin Farhad Ki Toh Nikal Padi
programme.desc: Farhad falls in love with Shirin and introduces her to his mother, but she is dismayed as Shirin is her sworn enemy.

programme.title: Footfairy
programme.desc: A CBI officer investigates a string of gruesome murders committed by a serial killer with a foot fetish. However, things take an ugly turn when he gets close to catching the killer.

programme.title: Khamoshiyan
programme.desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, journeys to Kashmir seeking inspiration and takes lodging in a mysterious guesthouse. He finds himself falling for Meera, the enigmatic owner, who harbours a dark secret.

programme.title: Love Express
programme.desc: Kanav and Ashmeet's parents fix their wedding. However, he learns that she is interested in another man, whom her parents disapprove of, and decides to help them unite.

programme.title: Saaya
programme.desc: Akash and Maya, two doctors, are happily married and expecting a baby. However, things take a turn when Maya's bus crashes, and she is believed to be dead.

programme.title: Doctor G
programme.desc: Uday Gupta, a medical student, the only male in the gynaecology department of a medical college, ends up in a series of hilarious situations due to his hesitance.

programme.title: Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai
programme.desc: An accident brings Karan and Pooja close to each other. When Karan finally decides to propose to her, he realises that destiny has other plans for them.

programme.title: Mrs.
programme.desc: Richa, a dancer and an independent woman, marries into the family of Diwakar, a doctor. However, things become complicated when she is forced to adhere to patriarchal standards for a wife.

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Maang
programme.desc: Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth, but she survives and seeks revenge.

programme.title: Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran
programme.desc: A team of Indian government officials must manoeuvre a high-stakes nuclear test in a town in Rajasthan without being detected by reconnaissance satellites or espionage networks.
